name: IL-12
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Mike Bost running with a large financial edge
Democratic challenger underfunded with no outside support
Markets price Bost at ~95% to win
model.rationale: The R+22 district lean, Bost's incumbency and roughly 15-to-1 fundraising advantage over Julie Fortier, and no outside spending or polling suggesting a race all point to a comfortable Republican hold. Prediction markets agree, pricing Bost near 95%.
model.watch: Any late surge of Democratic outside spending or a scandal involving Bost would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Mike Bost seeks another term in a southern Illinois district that leans heavily Republican, about 22 points toward the GOP at the baseline. He is a well-established incumbent with strong name recognition and no serious primary challenge to his renomination.

Democrat Julie Fortier has raised under $90,000 and holds modest cash, while Bost has raised over $1.3 million and has nearly $800,000 on hand. No outside groups are active, no public polls exist, and prediction markets give Bost roughly a 95% chance of winning. Everything points to a safe Republican seat.
